newsitem.title: USA: West Coast Entertainment buys 49 stores.
newsitem.headline: West Coast Entertainment buys 49 stores.

text.p: West Coast Entertainment Corp said Friday it had purchased 49 video stores in seven states for $26.1 million in cash and stock.
Under the deal, the company paid $14.8 million in cash and $11.2 million in stock.

The stores include the Great American Video chain in New York and New Jersey; Showcase and First Choice Video with stores in central Ohio; Wellesley Entertainment in Boston; and Reel Entertainment in Louisiana.
West Coast said it also purchased several of its franchise operations in Florida, Pennsylvania and New Jersey.
